Let me start by understanding the bug and the fix. The issue is that `json_encoder` and `json_decoder` were class-level attributes set to `None` on `Flask`, `Blueprint`, and `Scaffold`. When external code (like Flask-MongoEngine) tries to subclass `app.json_encoder` (which is `None`), it fails with `TypeError: NoneType takes no arguments`. The fix converts these to properties that return sensible defaults and emit deprecation warnings.
